question: Who received the Best Actress award at the 25th IIFA Awards in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitanshi Goel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Nitanshi Goel** received the Best Actress award at the prestigious 25th IIFA Awards in 2025, recognizing her outstanding performance in a leading role.
 
• Her performance in the film was widely acclaimed for its depth, emotional resonance, and nuanced portrayal of her character.
 
• The IIFA (International Indian Film Academy) Awards celebrate excellence in Indian cinema and are regarded as one of the most prestigious platforms for honoring talent in the film industry.
 
• Nitanshi Goel’s achievement marks a significant milestone in her career, showcasing her as one of the most promising talents in the industry.
 
• The recognition at IIFA underscores her versatility and dedication to her craft, earning her respect and admiration from both audiences and critics.
